title: DogzBarkMC
description: Replaces wolf sound variants with sounds of dog breeds from game Dogz 5!
body:
# DogzBarkMC
Hear your dog-friends again but in Minecraft with this resource pack! It **replaces** all wolf sound variants with dog breed sounds from the game Dogz 5. This pack will appeal not only to fans of the Dogz game but also to anyone who wants fresh, fitting sounds for their dogs and wolves!

## Personality alternatives
Each wolf's personality (sound variant) is replaced with sounds from specific breed:
- big → great dane
- classic → mutt
- cute → papillon
- puglin → pug
- angry → sheepdog
- grumpy → bulldog
- sad → dalmatian
> _Additionally, shaking and steps sounds have also been replaced with sounds from game!_

## How it works?
- In this resource pack, every Minecraft wolf sound has been removed and replaced with a specific sound of a specific breed from the Dogz game. The same applies to "shake" and "step" sounds.
- Nothing else has been changed or edited.
- It does not require any mods.
- It is compatible with other resource packs. If another pack also replaces wolf sounds, this pack will only work if it is placed higher in the resource pack list.
- If any mod triggers a wolf sound, it will typically play the sound from this resource pack.
- Some growl sounds repeats in different personalities because they do the same between different breed in the Dogz game.
- It should work in any version from 1.21.7 and higher (unless Mojang changes the wolf sound system), even if a warning appears.
